-- ============================================================
-- test-04-types_pos.fh  –  Typen PASS-Tests
--   (TYP-01..05, RNG-01..02, PRI-01..06, ERR-01..03)
-- ============================================================
module Test.Types.Pos

-- TYP-01: Einfacher Record
type Color is record
    red:   Integer
    green: Integer
    blue:  Integer
end record

-- TYP-02: Record mit allen Primitivtypen
type Metrics is record
    count:   Integer
    ratio:   Double
    label:   String
    active:  Boolean
    big_val: BigInteger
end record

-- TYP-03: Geschachtelter Record
type Pixel is record
    position: Color
    alpha:    Integer
end record

-- TYP-04: Generischer Record
type Container<T> is record
    item:  T
    count: Integer
end record

-- TYP-05: Proto-Field-IDs
type ProtoMsg is record
    id:      Integer proto 1
    payload: String  proto 2
    status:  Integer proto 3
end record

-- ERR-01: Error-Typen
error DatabaseError
error NetworkTimeout
error ValidationFailed

-- RNG-01: Typ-Alias ohne Range
type Score is Integer

-- RNG-02: Typen mit Range-Constraints
type Percentage  is Integer range 0..100
type Temperature is Double  range 0.0..100.0
type ByteVal     is Integer range 0..255

-- PRI-01..06: Primitive Typen in Feldern
function use_primitives(
    i: Integer,
    d: Double,
    s: String,
    b: Boolean,
    big: BigInteger
) returns Integer
requires i >= 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    return i
end use_primitives

-- TYP-01 Konstruktion
function make_color(r: Integer, g: Integer, bl: Integer) returns Color
requires r >= 0, r <= 255, g >= 0, g <= 255, bl >= 0, bl <= 255
ensures result.red = r, result.green = g, result.blue = bl
is
    return Color { red: r, green: g, blue: bl }
end make_color

-- TYP-03 Schachtelung
function make_pixel(r: Integer, g: Integer, bl: Integer, a: Integer) returns Pixel
requires r >= 0, g >= 0, bl >= 0, a >= 0, a <= 255
ensures result.alpha = a
is
    let col: Color = make_color(r, g, bl)
    return Pixel { position: col, alpha: a }
end make_pixel

-- ERR-03: Error-Typ in Result
function safe_op(n: Integer) returns Result<Integer, DatabaseError>
requires n >= 0
aborts DatabaseError when n = 0
ensures success, value >= 0
is
    if n = 0 then
        abort DatabaseError
    end if
    return ok n
end safe_op

end Test.Types.Pos
